subject.title: [regression] Bundled MCP config tempDir race still present on openclaw@2026.5.20 (#73244 reopened?)

question: Should the current whole-run artifact cleanup from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98934 be revised to also preserve `--mcp-config` artifacts for persistent Claude live sessions?
rationale: The later retry fix intentionally changed the same cleanup boundary that the earlier tempDir fix depended on, so a maintainer should confirm the desired lifecycle before automation rewrites it again.

options.title: Repair Unified Artifact Lifetime
options.body: Keep artifacts alive across persistent live sessions and fresh retries, then clean them exactly once when neither path can still use the argv paths.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Hold implementation until a maintainer or reporter captures the failing current-main live-session sequence with redacted logs or a reproducible harness.

options.title: Accept Run-Owned Cleanup
options.body: Leave the current retry-focused ownership unchanged and accept the risk that persistent live sessions can still reference deleted temp MCP config paths.

recommendation.title: Repair Unified Artifact Lifetime
recommendation.body: Keep artifacts alive across persistent live sessions and fresh retries, then clean them exactly once when neither path can still use the argv paths.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged retry-artifact ownership change that needs to be reconciled with the earlier tempDir lifecycle fix.
